sources_tried: Seed file research/installers/raw/seeds/montgomery.json: worked, but nearly all maps results are bathroom remodelers, plumbers, HVAC and stores, and the web results are Google redirect links with no domains. Nothing usable from it except the RSA Montgomery stalls page.
Existing research files (birmingham.json, mobile.json, pensacola.json, atlanta.json): used for regional leads (RSA, CBX Birmingham, TriMerge).
Bobrick find-a-rep: page loaded but rep results are behind a dropdown (dynamic); nothing listed.
Bradley, Hadrian, Metpar, General Partitions, Ampco locators: not tried (search budget and time).
The Blue Book (thebluebook.com search and iProView): 403 blocked.
BuildingConnected / Procore public profiles: not tried.

BBB partition category pages (Montgomery, Seale, Alabama statewide): worked. They yielded Terrell Enterprises and Dothan Commercial Doors; the other listings were office furniture companies and Georgia firms.
Web search: 8 of 8 used. Montgomery, Auburn, Columbus GA and Division 10 queries mostly returned spec documents, One Point Partitions and RSA pages. No Montgomery-based partition installer was found.

Company websites fetched: restroomstallsandall.com (Alabama, Montgomery and Auburn pages), accessoriesunlimited.net, dothancommercialdoors.com, terrellenterprises.com, closetsplus.com, division10inc.com (Cordova TN, says it serves Alabama but is about 280 miles away, so I excluded it).

candidates.name: TriMerge Construction Group LLC
candidates.partition_evidence: Expired (Mar 2025) job posting for a 'Commercial Restroom Partition Installer' in Birmingham, AL: install all types of restroom partitions, hardware and accessories; 100% traveling.
red_flags: No company website or contact found
Base city and service area unconfirmed
Only evidence is an expired job ad
candidates.reason: A job ad shows it hires commercial restroom partition installers for travelling work out of Birmingham, but the business itself, its base and its service area could not be verified.

license.name: TriMerge Construction Group LLC
license.registry: Alabama Licensing Board for General Contractors license roster (licensesearch.alabama.gov/genconbd)
license.note: Checked 2026-11-20. The roster has no entry for 'TriMerge', 'Tri-Merge' or 'Tri Merge'. The only 'merge' match is MEDIAMERGE INC of Chelsea, AL, a low-voltage firm that is unrelated. The firm's base city is not confirmed. A license is required only for jobs at or above the $50,000 threshold, and Montgomery has no local installer rule.

candidates.name: Building Specialties Company (BSCO), now CBX Solutions, Birmingham branch
candidates.partition_evidence: Former Cook & Boardman branch page (now redirecting to the CBX Birmingham branch) listed Division 10 specialties incl. toilet partitions and bathroom accessories; CBX site returned 403 so installation scope not read.
red_flags: Distributor that supplies partitions (buy-around risk)
Branch page blocked (403); contact details not read
Does not state it serves Montgomery
candidates.reason: Large Division 10 distributor about 90 miles away that supplies toilet partitions; installation for partitions not confirmed and Montgomery service not stated.

candidates.name: Terrell Enterprises, Inc.
candidates.partition_evidence: School/office furniture dealer offering delivery and installation; ASI Global Partitions appears among partner logos, but partitions are not named as a service.
red_flags: Primarily a school furniture dealer
Phone differs on BBB listing ((334) 382-7415) vs site; site notes phone problems
If an ASI dealer, may sell partitions (buy-around risk)

license.name: Terrell Enterprises, Inc.
license.registry: Alabama Licensing Board for General Contractors license roster (licensesearch.alabama.gov/genconbd)
license.note: Checked 2026-11-20. The roster has no entry containing 'Terrell'. All Greenville, AL licensees were reviewed and none match. A license is required only for jobs at or above the $50,000 threshold, and Montgomery has no local installer rule. candidates.name: Restroom Stalls and All (RSA)
candidates.review_source: Google (as shown on its own site); also BBB A+ accredited
candidates.partition_evidence: Site says RSA installs commercial restroom partitions and Division 10 products with its own W2 crews in GA, FL, AL, TN, SC, NC.
red_flags: Sells and ships partitions nationwide itself (buy-around risk / competitor)
Base about 200 miles from Montgomery, beyond the 120-mile regional limit
candidates.reason: A real commercial partition installer that lists Alabama as an install state, but it is based about 200 miles away (beyond the 120-mile limit) and is a direct partition seller. Out of area by the rule; worth revisiting only if the area rule is relaxed for statewide crews.

candidates.name: Accessories Unlimited Inc (AUI)
candidates.partition_evidence: Toilet partitions listed as a product category; 'Full Service Installation' listed but not stated for partitions.
red_flags: Supplies partitions itself (buy-around risk)
Based about 160+ miles from Montgomery, beyond regional limit
candidates.reason: Division 10 supplier with installation offered and Alabama in its service list, but based in metro Atlanta beyond the 120-mile limit and sells partitions.

candidates.name: One Point Partitions
candidates.partition_evidence: Site returned 403; search snippets describe it as a toilet partition distributor with Alabama delivery terminals (Birmingham, Decatur, Loxley, Cusseta) and DIY install tutorials; snippets contradict each other on installation.
red_flags: Online partition distributor (direct competitor / buy-around risk)
Site blocks access (403); only search snippets seen
Templated city pages (Montgomery, Mobile, Atlanta, Birmingham) suggest lead-gen, not a local installer
Montgomery office claim not verified
candidates.reason: Appears to be an online partition seller with city landing pages and DIY install guidance; no verified installation crews or local base. Competitor rather than installer.

candidates.name: Dothan Commercial Doors, LLC
candidates.partition_evidence: Lists toilet partitions and restroom accessories as products it supplies; no installation stated.
red_flags: Supplies partitions (buy-around risk)
Service area is SE Alabama / SW Georgia / N Florida; Montgomery not listed
candidates.reason: Commercial supplier about 95 miles away whose stated service area does not include Montgomery, and its site does not say it installs partitions.

candidates.name: Closet Plus, Inc.
candidates.partition_evidence: Commercial page lists toilet partitions and Division 10 specialties for West Alabama; mentions 'delivered only' quotes; installation not stated.

Service area is Tuscaloosa / West Alabama, not Montgomery
candidates.reason: Division 10 supplier serving West Alabama about 110 miles away; its site does not say it serves Montgomery or that it installs partitions.
